raw_text: At the Ramgarh field a contract workman tripped over a steel pipe rack on the work platform and fell to the ground. He sustained soreness and pain in his left hip.
osha_event_title: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object
osha_narrative: An employee tripped on the edge of a pallet and fell to the floor, suffering an injury to the left hip.

raw_text: At Tanot field an oilfield fitter was erecting a pipe scaffold when he lost his footing and fell approximately 11 feet to a lower level. The fall caused traumatic injuries of unspecified type.
osha_narrative: An employee fell approximately 11 feet while erecting a pipe scaffold.

raw_text: At Naharkatiya field an employee was aligning 200-pound pipe racks on the production line when his little finger was caught between two racks. The finger was crushed and required amputation.
osha_event_title: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment
osha_narrative: An employee was lining up 200-pound racks on a production line. His little finger was crushed between two of the racks, resulting in an amputation.

raw_text: 27/03/21 employee was walking over a mud yrd island when she slippd on wet leaves and fell. Right ankle fracturd, she was taken to hospital for surgery. Usko kaha gaya dhyaan se chalna but she was busy.
